meta.source: NYS Liquor Authority, Current Liquor Authority Active Licenses (data.ny.gov 9s3h-dpkz), Kings County records retrieved 2026-09-14, assigned to Brooklyn Community District 6 by point-in-polygon on the DCP boundary with boundary-adjacent addresses checked against NYC Geoclient
meta.new_definition: A new license is one whose license number year matches its issue year, so it has not been renewed. new_2026: first issued in calendar 2026. new_90 and new_30: first issued within 90 or 30 days of 2026-09-14. Renewals of older licenses carry a recent issue date and are not counted.
meta.website_logo_method: Websites from OpenStreetMap website tags (Geofabrik New York extract, 2026-08-31) matched by name within 80 m of the SLA coordinate at a strict similarity threshold. Logos fetched from each site: img tagged logo, then apple-touch-icon, then og:image, then favicon; icons under 32 px dropped. Logo files are the businesses' own marks, used for identification.
